date_note: Date of the forum post, as given by Tech-ish Kenya (published 24 Nov).
title: A hacker claims to have stolen 600GB of identity documents from eCitizen (unconfirmed claim)
summary: Tech-ish Kenya reports that a forum user called ByteToBreach claims to have copied about 740GB from eCitizen: 600GB of KYC documents, plus 100GB of databases and 40GB of source code. The post went up on 22 November. On 24 November the State Department for Immigration and Citizen Services said it is investigating reports of unauthorised access, according to The Kenya Times.
plain: A hacker says they took about 740GB of data from Kenya's eCitizen portal. The State Department says it is investigating reports of unauthorised access and that eCitizen remains operational. The claim itself is unconfirmed.
exec: An unverified hacker claim of about 740GB from a Kenyan government portal; the State Department says it is investigating reports of unauthorised access.
action: The State Department for Immigration and Citizen Services urges the public to remain cautious while investigations continue.

validation.note: Claim relayed by Tech-ish Kenya; the State Department's statement (via The Kenya Times, kenya-today.com) says it is investigating reports of unauthorised access but does not confirm the claimed scope.
